visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a wood-paneled cabin room, a young woman wearing a light purple knit beanie and a white fleece hoodie focuses intently on her smartphone. She is speaking and looking up occasionally at the person filming. (2) The camera pans down to reveal a low wooden table completely covered in a massive variety of Japanese snacks, including various instant noodle cups, bags of chips, snacks, bananas, and canned drinks. The woman reappears in the frame, laughing heartily and looking at the impressive food hoard. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor ski resort on a bright, sunny day. Two women dressed in pink and purple snowboarding gear sit on the snowy slope with their boards attached. They are laughing and interacting playfully for the camera. (4) One of the women attempts a move and falls onto the snow, followed by another shot of the woman in pink falling flat on her back. A yellow cartoonish 'dizzy star' animation is edited over her head to emphasize the impact. (5) A snowboarding montage ensues, showing the women gliding down the mountain slopes. The background reveals a vast mountain landscape with a ski lift and distant trees. (6) Returning to the indoor wooden room at night, two women are attempting to stretch on the floor. They are overcome with fits of hysterical laughter, appearing to be in playful pain or exhaustion. A third woman in a white hoodie walks across the background as they continue to laugh on the carpet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a female voice speaking Mandarin excitedly in an indoor environment, accompanied by a low-volume pop BGM. A series of rustling sounds from snack packaging can be heard under the speech. (2) Loud, collective female laughter erupts, causing a significant peak in loudness and spectral brightness. The laughter is high-pitched and genuine. (3) The scene transitions to the outdoors; the sound of wind buffeting the microphone and the rhythmic scraping of snowboards on hard-packed snow take center stage. (4) A countdown of '1, 2, 3' is shouted, followed by a loud 'thud' and more laughter as a person falls. The BGM increases in intensity, featuring a clear electronic beat. (5) A full pop track with female vocals dominates as the sound of gliding over snow continues in the background. (6) In the final phase, the audio consists of high-pitched laughing and strained vocal groans from physical exertion during stretching, mixed with conversational Mandarin about pain.
